title: Language-neutral vector format
description: Engineering consequence of DVC QR example, machine-readable summary (test participant XXA); Stakeholder directive: Kotlin library first, Rust library second.

statements.label: Language-neutral vector format
statements.requirement: Conformance vectors SHALL be stored once, in a language-neutral format (JSON plus PEM), in this repository, and loaded by both test suites.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-TST-005 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-TST-004 STT-TST-005 the shared negative vectors fail at the named step with the named reason` (ConformanceVectorsTest.kt); node-smoke.mjs).
